Segnala offerta di lavoro If you’ve worn a pair of glasses, we’ve already met. We are a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames, and sunglasses. We offer our industry stakeholders in over 150 countries access to a global platform of high-quality vision care products (such as the Essilor brand, with Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest and Transitions), iconic brands that consumers love (such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear and Costa), as well as a network that offers consumers high-quality vision care and best-in-class shopping experiences (such as Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò and the GrandVision network), and leading e-commerce platforms. Join our global community of over 190,000 dedicated employees around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry. Discover more by following us on LinkedIn ! Your #FutureInSight with EssilorLuxottica Are you willing to pioneer new frontiers, foster inclusivity and collaboration, embrace agility, ignite passion, and make a positive impact on the world? Join us in redefining the boundaries of what’s possible. Your role We are looking for a senior eCommerce Merchandise Manager Optical to lead the merchandising strategy for our online optical business. The role will be responsible for shaping the assortment strategy, driving commercial performance, supporting product launches and turning data-driven insights into clear business actions across global eCommerce banners. This position reports directly to the Global eCommerce Merchandising Director and will work closely with Category Management, Planning, eCommerce Business teams, RX Operations, Marketing, Finance and local market teams. Main Responsibilities Define and execute the e-commerce merchandising strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs, and market opportunities. Develop assortment plans and product mix strategies across banners and markets, optimizing brand, category, and pricing architecture. Partner with Category Management teams to drive online-exclusive launches, limited editions, private label initiatives, and distribution strategies. Translate new collection launches and product roadmaps into actionable merchandising plans for e-commerce, site merchandising, and local market teams. Lead promotional and markdown strategies, including seasonal campaigns, flash sales, Cyber Week, and key commercial events, balancing growth and profitability. Define pricing, discount, and clearance strategies to maximize inventory productivity, margin performance, and customer value. Monitor sales, margin, traffic, conversion, and assortment performance, identifying opportunities to improve commercial results across digital channels. Deliver product performance analysis, merchandising reviews, and actionable insights to support data-driven business decisions and strategic planning. Drive cross-functional collaboration with Category Management, RX Operations, Marketing, and local teams to ensure consistent commercial execution. Lead merchandising activities for strategic growth initiatives, including AI Glasses and other innovation programs, supporting forecasting, distribution planning, assortment evolution, and performance optimization. Main Requirements At least 10 years of experience in eCommerce merchandising, digital retail, category management, buying, planning or commercial strategy. Strong experience in optical, eyewear, fashion, retail or consumer goods is highly preferred. Proven ability to manage assortment strategy, commercial campaigns, markdowns, product launches and performance analysis. Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to connect product performance, customer behavior, sales, margin and inventory data. Solid business acumen and ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in a matrix organization. Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and markets at the same time. Clear communication style and ability to translate complex information into simple, actionable recommendations. Fluent English is required; additional languages are a plus. What’s In It For You In EssilorLuxottica, you are not defined just by your job title. Each career adventure is unique; have a glimpse of some of the benefits you will enjoy as a successful candidate: Access to our cutting-edge learning platform, Leonardo, and personalized development programs to help you grow professionally and personally. Enjoy flexible work conditions, health insurance coverage, ticket restaurants, internal rooftop canteen. Access special offers for employees on a vast range of eyewear, eye care products, and fashion apparel, so you can enjoy our world-class brands firsthand. Enjoy our “Disconnect Program” a holistic approach to work-life balance, including initiatives for mental health, yoga, jogging sessions, and more, designed to help you recharge and stay healthy. Recruiting process Our recruitment process may vary; If you are selected, you will be contacted by our recruiters to guide you through the specific steps for your application. Salary Package Annual Gross Salary: 50.000 Eur – 55.000 Eur Performance Bonus: An additional Management by Objectives (MBO) bonus as percentage of the annual gross salary. Comprehensive Benefits Package: Supplementary Health insurance coverage Supplementary Pension Plan Access to the EssilorLuxottica Corporate Welfare Catalog Transportation – Discounted pass Meal Vouchers as per company guidelines Exclusive employee discounts on company products Company-provided laptop and mobile phone Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitment We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and provide equal opportunities to all, regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. Job Purpose The Digital Applications Product Manager is accountable for the vision, strategy, governance, and business performance of the Digital Retail Applications portfolio. The role leads the Digital Applications Product team and drives the evolution of solutions supporting Clienteling, Retail Operations, Omnichannel Services, Event Management, Repair, MTM/MTO and future retail innovation initiatives across all brands and regions. Acting as a strategic partner to Business, Digital and IT leadership, the role ensures that product investments deliver measurable business value, operational efficiency and a consistent omnichannel customer experience. Responsibilities Define and own the Digital Applications strategy and multi-year roadmap. Establish product vision, priorities, governance and investment decisions across the portfolio. Ensure alignment between Digital initiatives, business objectives and brand strategy. Identify opportunities for innovation, scalability and process transformation. Oversee the Digital Applications ecosystem and product lifecycle management. Prioritize initiatives based on business value, strategic relevance and resource capacity. Manage dependencies across Digital, IT and business functions. Ensure consistency across all retail digital products and customer journeys. Lead, coach and develop Product Owners and Product Specialists. Define team objectives and performance expectations. Foster product management best practices and continuous improvement. Partner with senior stakeholders across Retail, CRM and Client Development, Operations, Marketing and IT. Facilitate strategic alignment and decision-making. Represent the Digital Applications domain within global transformation programs. Define and monitor product KPIs and business outcomes. Manage product budgets, resource allocation and investment priorities. Drive adoption, operational efficiency and business value realization. Knowledge & Skills Minimum 8 years of experience in retail/ clienteling/ digital product management. Strong understanding of clienteling workflows and user experiences in luxury industry. Solid background, with digital App: design and backend integration patterns. Strong analytical mindset with experience working with digital KPIs and business performance analysis. Advanced knowledge of Atlassian tools (Confluence, Jira). Knowledge of reporting tools (Power BI, Adobe, etc.). Very good usage of AGILE and Waterfall operating model and project management and familiarity with SCRUM, Agile or Design Sprint methodologies. Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Ability to maintain positive and healthy relationships with all project team members and stakeholders. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and international teams. English B2 or above, both written and spoken. RAL €55.000 - €60.000 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.
